title: A Contradiction Judge Counted Reported Teammate Errors as Hallucinations: An Assertion-Aware Re-Score of One Multi-Agent LLM Harness
abstract: arXiv:2606.21666v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: LLM judges that score hallucination flag any statement that contradicts a reference fact. Agents in multi-agent LLM systems quote and dispute each other's claims, so such a judge can count a correct report of a teammate's error as a hallucination. An earlier version of this study, a preprint (arXiv:2606.21666v1), reported that broadcasting raised a hallucination rate from 0.492 to 0.658 (+34%) and called it contamination; this version withdraws that claim, and the preprint's runs cannot be re-scored. An unpublished revision of that harness reported 0.289 to 0.554 (+0.265, 95% CI [0.225, 0.305]), and its saved outputs are re-scored here. Under an analysis plan fixed before any judge call, three judges from three vendors labeled each of six facts in 1,832 outputs as asserted wrong, attributed to another source, asserted correct or absent. On values that outputs assert as their own, the broadcast effect was -0.0208 (95% CI [-0.0458, +0.

translated_title: 矛盾评判器将所报告的队友错误计为幻觉：对一种多智能体LLM框架的断言感知重评分
translated_abstract: 用于评估幻觉的LLM评判器会标记任何与参考事实相矛盾的陈述。多智能体LLM系统中的智能体会引用并质疑彼此的声明，因此这类评判器可能把对队友错误的正确报告计为幻觉。本研究的早期版本（预印本arXiv:2606.21666v1）曾报告广播式传播使幻觉率从0.492升至0.658（+34%），并将其称为“污染”；本版本撤回该结论，且该预印本的运行记录已无法重新评分。该框架的一个未发表修订版报告幻觉率从0.289升至0.554（+0.265，95%置信区间[0.225, 0.305]），本文对其保存的输出进行了重新评分。在评判器调用之前即已固定的分析方案下，来自三家供应商的三个评判器对1,832个输出中的六项事实逐一标注为：断言错误、归属其他来源、断言正确或未提及。对于输出断言为自身所得的数值，广播效应为-0.0208（95%置信区间[-0.0458, +0.…（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出断言感知的重评分方法，揭示基于矛盾检测的LLM幻觉评判器会将多智能体系统中对队友错误的正确报告误判为幻觉，并据此撤回了先前“广播导致幻觉率上升”的结论——在仅计输出自身断言的数值时，广播效应实为-0.0208。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that a contradiction-based LLM hallucination judge miscounts correct reports of teammate errors as hallucinations in multi-agent systems, and an assertion-aware re-scoring that separates self-asserted errors from attributed ones withdraws the earlier claim that broadcasting increases hallucination rates (revised effect: -0.0208).
